item.title: Composition Analysis and Identification of Ancient Glass Artifacts
item.description: A Provincial First Prize project for Problem C of the 2022 CUMCM, analyzing weathering, composition changes, and type identification for ancient glass artifacts through statistical modeling and classification.

item.title: “Have You Subscribed?” | Online Music Willingness-to-Pay Study
item.description: Studied online music payment through user behavior and consumer psychology, validated the survey instrument, and used a random forest to turn payment drivers into platform recommendations.
